tasks.short: Supply, operate and maintain protective equipment

steps.what: Supply suitable personal protective equipment to the people doing the work
Operate personal protective equipment and check its actual operation for the intended use
Maintain personal protective equipment according to its actual condition and authorized instructions
outputs: maintained equipment or identified replacement need

tasks.design: Keep physical supply, operation and maintenance with the technician. A catalogue in {PROCUREMENT} can support purchasing, but does not replace handling and checking protective equipment in this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Equipment condition and operation must be checked physically.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing catalogues hold specifications without performing these actions.
tasks.still_hard: Recognize equipment that is unsuitable despite looking intact.
tasks.human_edge: Handle and check the actual protective equipment.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: catalogue software does not perform physical protective-equipment operation or maintenance.

assumptions: Boundary covers the three stated physical actions. A separate issue or maintenance record is not established by this statement; if present it must be split and assessed rather than folded into handling.
Inputs are existing approved requirements and actual equipment; no new structured capture is required. Native catalogue functions do not change this physical work.
Shares are illustrative rather than measured and all remain fully retained. No software change means zero upkeep.
unknowns: Whether the local task includes a separate equipment issue or maintenance entry
research_questions: Observe any actual equipment record and test native forms for that separate action.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Physical equipment supply, operation and maintenance are fully retained; no separate administrative work is established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train workers in safety procedures for green jobs

steps.what: Consult the current approved safety procedures and training material for the actual green-job work
inputs: current approved task procedures and training material

steps.what: Explain and demonstrate safety procedures such as fall-protection device use or proper ventilation during wind turbine construction
inputs: actual training equipment and workers' questions

steps.what: Observe workers practicing the procedures and correct their actual technique and understanding

tasks.design: Use the existing native approved-material views in {DOCS} and {LMS}, then keep demonstration and observed practice with the technician. No generated safety procedure or invented training-completion record is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safe technique must be demonstrated and checked in the actual work context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing training references support delivery without replacing practice checks.
tasks.still_hard: A worker may repeat the instructions yet apply the technique incorrectly.
tasks.human_edge: See the actual practice and give an immediate correction.

ambition.what: No increase in training span claimed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: procedural safety training needs observation and correction of actual worker practice.

assumptions: Boundary includes material consultation, demonstration and actual practice assessment. No separate completion entry or certificate is specified; if one exists it belongs after actual training and must be decomposed.
Safety owner supplies versioned approved material; technician selects the actual job context. Missing or unsuitable content requires human resolution, not generated procedures.
Native material access already suffices in this scenario and earns no saving. Shares are illustrative, not observed baselines; no change means zero upkeep.
unknowns: Whether separate attendance or completion records are kept
research_questions: Observe any record write separately and preserve its post-training lifecycle.

incremental.description: No introduced system or recording process

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Explicit reference lookup, instruction and actual practice assessment all remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain environmental records with traceable sources

steps.what: Collect and verify actual environmental measurement records, source documents and required record categories
inputs: actual environmental records and measurement documents
outputs: checked source documents and identified record gaps

steps.what: Enter or update the environmental record's site, date, source, document type and version fields
inputs: checked source documents and identified record gaps

steps.what: Arrange the source documents and metadata into the environmental documentation index
inputs: checked source documents and identified record gaps
outputs: complete environmental record and documentation index draft

steps.what: Check the complete record and documentation index against sources and required categories and select the final update
inputs: complete environmental record and documentation index draft

steps.what: Save the checked update in the same environmental records system

tasks.design: Configure native record templates and document links in the environmental records system {OPS_SYSTEM}, using actual sources in {DOCS}. Reuse existing site and document metadata and build the index natively; the technician verifies completeness and the final update before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated metadata entry and document indexing add maintenance effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record forms and document version links can reuse established fields.
tasks.still_hard: A tidy index does not prove that a required measurement or source document exists.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize missing evidence and keep gaps visible.

ambition.what: No automatic regulatory submission or compliance certification.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-7; environmental record access and applicable consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: environmental records systems can reuse metadata and index source documents, with completeness checked by the responsible technician.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is environmental records management. Boundary covers maintaining records and documentation, not performing measurements or sending filings. No legal requirements are generated.

Measurement and document owners supply actual source files; safety specialist maintains the existing requirements register with category and version. Technician collects and verifies sources in s1 and enters missing metadata in s2; absent documents remain gaps rather than inferred records.
Native templates and links first. Shares are provisional scenarios. Final correctness checking is existing record-maintenance work after the complete update exists, not an added approval role.
Same-system save receives 1% fully retained. Gross 20 minus 1 upkeep yields 19 net; existing source-system runtime earns no labour credit.
unknowns: Actual repeated metadata and indexing workload
research_questions: Do native templates reduce metadata and index work without hiding missing or superseded evidence?

already_counted.description: Review reused metadata, documentation index and final completeness

incremental.description: Maintain record templates and document-category mappings

approvals.approved_version: checked complete documentation update from s4; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if existing templates already cover maintenance; up to 13% where source gaps reduce central 19% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Consult on workplace application of safety principles

steps.what: Review the organization's existing workplace information and applicable approved safety references
outputs: source-checked workplace context and relevant principles

steps.what: Determine how safety principles, practices and techniques apply to the actual workplace context and where specialist input is needed
inputs: source-checked workplace context and relevant principles

steps.what: Provide consultation to the organization or agency and clarify how the advice applies in practice
outputs: explained workplace application and clarified limitations

tasks.design: Use native approved-reference indexing in {DOCS} to assist source retrieval. The technician interprets workplace application and provides the actual consultation, referring beyond-scope questions to a specialist; no generated safety recommendation or new report is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the approved reference can interrupt consultation preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference indexing can reduce navigation.
tasks.still_hard: A general principle may be insufficient for an unusual exposure or work arrangement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize missing context and the limits of the technician's competence.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: reference indexing assists retrieval while applying safety principles to a workplace requires contextual judgement.

assumptions: Boundary covers source review, interpretation and live consultation. The statement establishes no separately authored report, send or workplace control action.
Organization supplies existing workplace facts; reference owner supplies approved documents with version and scope. Missing facts are clarified during s3, not assumed structured or generated.
Native indexing first. Shares and retrieval reduction are provisional; gross 1.5 minus 0.3 upkeep gives 1.2 net. All interpretation and consultation stays retained.
unknowns: Current reference navigation and actual workplace-information quality
research_questions: Can native indexing reduce retrieval effort without presenting a general reference as site-specific approval?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if references already suffice; up to 0.8% for smaller retrieval gains than central 1.2% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Technicians retain physical equipment work, observed safety instruction and contextual consultation; native forms assist environmental documentation.
skills_to_grow: Recognize when safety advice requires specialist input
role.ambitious_version: Traceable environmental documentation while practical safety work remains accountable to people.
